onboarding.welcomeBody: A Quranic verse each day, accurate prayer times, and gentle Azan reminders — built with care, ad-free for Premium users, and respectful of your privacy.
onboarding.locationBody: We use your location only to compute accurate prayer times. Coordinates stay on your device — they're never sent to our servers.
onboarding.locationUnavailableBody: You can set your location later in Settings.
onboarding.notifBody: Get a gentle local notification at each of the five daily prayers. You can toggle individual prayers in the Prayers tab anytime.
onboarding.notifDisabledBody: You can enable Azan reminders later in Settings.
onboarding.skipLink: Skip — set up later in Settings

home.comeBackTomorrow: Come back tomorrow, or unlock the full archive with Premium.
home.locationNeeded: Set your location in Settings to see prayer times.

prayers.title: Today's Prayers
prayers.locationNeededSubtitle: Open Settings → Location to compute today's prayer times.

archive.lockedSubtitle: Browse and favorite past wisdom cards. Unlock with Premium.

settings.notifHelp: Toggle individual prayers in the Prayers tab.
settings.feedbackHelp: Found a bug or have a suggestion? We'd love to hear from you.
settings.deleteHelp: Removes your prayer history, streak, favorites, and settings on this device and in the cloud.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently remove your prayer history, streak, favorites, and settings — both on this device and from the cloud. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteSuccessBody: Your data has been removed. Please close and reopen the app.
settings.deleteFailBody: Some data may not have been deleted. Check your connection and try again.
settings.emailMissingBody: Install Gmail (or any email app) to send feedback. Or write to growthwithshehroz.app@gmail.com
settings.emailFailBody: Write to growthwithshehroz.app@gmail.com directly with your feedback.
